content.text: In a fortnight, Donegal will set their sights on the All-Ireland final, where they will face a Kerry team that effortlessly handled Tyrone, much like how McGuinness' squad managed to defeat Meath.

In their pursuit of reaching an All-Ireland decider for the first time in 24 years, Meath has triumphed over Dublin, Kerry, and Galway during an impressive giant-killing season, with the final match set for Sunday at Croke Park at 16:00 BST.
